playbookInput.precedingConversationSummary: Customer can have multiple reasons like: Customers want to change their appointment OR Customer want to know their ticket status OR  Customer want to book appointment  so if user says something gibberish first time give the first no match response and if user again says something gibberish then give second one and even after that if user same something gibberish then send them to bell_No_Match_3 flow.

playbookOutput.executionSummary: Customer says nonsensical/gibberish information 3 times so flow bell_global_error_count_check is called each time and VA responds as per instructions and on 3rd time call the bell_No_Match_3 flow.
